flows.label: CLI Dispatch & Command Resolution
flows.description: Main entry point: parse arguments and dispatch to the appropriate command handler. Registry.Dispatch orchestrates command matching and execution.

flows.label: MCP Server (stdio)
flows.description: Start the Model Context Protocol server on stdin/stdout for AI assistants. Registers all MCP tools and listens for JSON-RPC requests.

flows.label: MCP Server (HTTP)
flows.description: Start the MCP server on an HTTP port for HTTP client access. Shares the same tool registry as stdio mode.

flows.label: Project Initialization
flows.description: Initialize a project: create global config and vault, write project config, set up agent file wiring, generate slash-command shims, and install hooks.

flows.label: Semantic Search
flows.description: Perform hybrid vector + structural search across vault content. Embeds query, searches indexes, filters by wing/room/hall, and boosts results.

flows.label: Session Capture & Indexing
flows.description: Capture an AI session: write metadata, analyze friction, chunk and embed transcript, extract entities, build knowledge graph, and index for search.

flows.label: Context Bootstrap
flows.description: Load full session context at turn 1: retrieve workflow, resume, active tasks, and recent sessions via MCP vp_bootstrap_context tool.

flows.label: Content Absorption (Legacy Migration)
flows.description: Migrate legacy agent-context files (CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules) into the vault. Builds plan, presents interactive routing, rewrites source files, and stages changes.

flows.label: Session Archive
flows.description: Archive an AI session transcript with provenance manifest: compress, compute SHA256, sign, and store under vault/Projects/<slug>/transcripts/.

flows.label: Knowledge Graph Queries
flows.description: Query the temporal knowledge graph: retrieve entities, relationships, timelines, and perform time-travel queries.

flows.label: Command Management
flows.description: List, retrieve, and upgrade embedded commands. Slash-command templates are materialized from embedded defaults and editable in the vault.

flows.label: Skill Management
flows.description: List, show, and upgrade expert skills. Skills contain SKILL.md with personas and reference documents for domain-specific guidance.

flows.label: Palace Navigation
flows.description: Browse palace structure: list wings and rooms (spatial metaphor for vault content organization), traverse, and find tunnels (cross-project links).

flows.label: Vault Synchronization
flows.description: Pull and push vault to git remote. Enables distributed access to the persistent memory store.

flows.label: Legacy Data Migration
flows.description: Migrate data from older tools: import vibe-vault (vv) session notes and MemPalace data into vibe-palace vault structure.

flows.label: Room Classification Tuning
flows.description: Audit and tune room classification: adjust keyword weights, run algorithmic audits, and optionally use offline LLM for weight discovery.

flows.label: Friction Analysis & Trends
flows.description: Analyze session difficulty: compute friction scores from transcripts and track trends over time to identify pain points.
